data.name: A configured override wins over the client on every backend attempt, including same-dialect direct forwarding. Fallback attempts use the newly selected backend's own settings.
data.value: En konfigureret override har forrang frem for klienten ved hver backendforsøg, herunder direkte videresending med samme dialekt. Fallback-forsøg bruger den nyvalgte backends egne indstillinger.

data.name: A non-empty value is sent verbatim as reasoning_effort for Chat Completions or reasoning.effort for Responses. An existing chat_template_kwargs.reasoning_effort is also overridden so it cannot take priority over your depth setting. No depth names are translated into booleans.
data.value: En ikke-tom værdi sendes som den er som reasoning_effort for Chat Completions eller reasoning.effort for Responses. En eksisterende chat_template_kwargs.reasoning_effort overskrives også, så den ikke kan have forrang over din dybdeindstilling. Ingen dybdenavne oversættes til booleans.

data.name: Do not override leaves that setting to the client, or to the upstream default when absent. Same-dialect requests retain their original fields; cross-dialect requests use the gateway's protocol translation.
data.value: Overskriv ikke, så indstillingen overdrages til klienten eller til standardopstillingen opstrøms, når den er fraværende. Anmodninger med samme dialekt beholder deres oprindelige felter; anmodninger med forskellige dialekter bruger gatewayens protokollover­sættelse.

data.name: For Ollama-native backends, Force on or Force off sends boolean think. For OpenAI Chat or Responses backends, it writes chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking. Other template arguments are preserved. This is a vLLM-style extension, not a universal OpenAI switch; leave it unconfigured for providers that do not support it.
data.value: For Ollama-native backends, Force on or Force off sends boolean think. For OpenAI Chat or Responses backends, it writes chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking. Other template arguments are preserved. This is a vLLM-style extension, not a universal OpenAI switch; leave it unconfigured for providers that do not support it.

data.name: Supported depths and whether thinking can be disabled depend on the model and provider. Unsupported extensions may be rejected or ignored. Check the provider's documentation; the gateway does not infer capabilities from its name.
data.value: De understøttede dybder og om tankeprocessen kan deaktiveres afhænger af modellen og udbyderen. Uunderstøttede udvidelser kan blive afvist eller ignoreret. Tjek udbyderens dokumentation; gatewayen udleder ikke evner ud fra dens navn.

data.name: The switch and depth are independent. With vLLM, an explicit enable_thinking value takes precedence over automatic activation by depth. Avoid conflicting settings such as Force off with a high depth, or Force on with depth {0}. A depth alone does not force thinking on against an explicit client switch.
data.value: Skiftet og dybden er uafhængige. Med vLLM har en eksplicit enable_thinking-værdi forrang frem for automatisk aktivering via dybde. Undgå modsætningsfyldte indstillinger som Force off med en høj dybde, eller Force on med dybde {0}. En dybde alene tvinger ikke tænkning til mod en eksplicit klient-skift.

data.name: The switch controls enable_thinking independently of depth. Qwen3.8 supports low, medium and xhigh, with xhigh as its default. To keep thinking enabled, select Force on and a supported depth such as xhigh.
data.value: Switchen styrer enable_thinking uafhængigt af dybden. Qwen3.8 understøtter low, medium og xhigh, hvor xhigh er standardværdien. For at holde tænkning aktiveret, skal du vælge Force on og en understøttet dybde, såsom xhigh.

data.name: Usually leave the switch unconfigured and set only a depth supported by the underlying model, such as high or medium. Do not assume enable_thinking is supported.
data.value: Lad normalt switchen være ukonfigureret og angiv kun en dybde, der understøttes af den underliggende model, f.eks. high eller medium. Antag ikke, at enable_thinking understøttes.

data.name: Valid values vary by model. These are examples, not a promise that every provider accepts the same controls.
data.value: De gyldige værdier varierer afhængigt af modellen. Disse er eksempler, ikke et løfte om, at alle udbydere accepterer de samme indstillinger.

data.name: When accessed through an OpenAI-compatible proxy, follow that proxy's contract. These controls do not generate native Claude thinking/budget fields or Gemini thinking configuration.
data.value: Når der tilgås via en OpenAI-kompatibel proxy, skal proxyens kontrakt overholdes. Disse kontroller genererer ikke native Claude thinking/budget-felter eller Gemini thinking-konfiguration.
